description.text:
[Software Engineer｜Cloud Backend & AI Automation
About the Role
EnGenius Software Team is looking for a Software Engineer who enjoys coding, solving complex problems, and exploring Cloud, AI, and Automation technologies.
You will work on the backend development, system integration, and troubleshooting of the EnGenius Cloud management platform, while also applying AI tools and automation approaches to improve development, testing, debugging, and engineering efficiency.
We do not expect you to know everything from day one. What matters most is your hands-on ability, problem-solving mindset, and willingness to dig into unfamiliar issues and find practical solutions.
What You’ll Do
1. Develop, maintain, and troubleshoot EnGenius Cloud backend services.
2. Build APIs, data processing functions, and system integrations.
3. Analyze, reproduce, and resolve software and cloud-related customer issues.
4. Use AI tools to support coding, debugging, testing, and technical research.
5. Develop automation tools or scripts to improve engineering and operational efficiency.
6. Research Cloud, AI, and software technologies and prepare technical documentation.
7. Collaborate with PM, QA, R&D, and other teams to clarify requirements and resolve issues.
8. Support system testing, deployment, integration, and post-release troubleshooting.
What We’re Looking For
• Hands-on coding experience in at least one programming language such as Python, Java, JavaScript, C#, or similar languages.
• Basic knowledge of databases, SQL, and RESTful APIs.
• Experience in backend development, web applications, cloud applications, or system integration is preferred.
• Strong logical thinking, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
• Willingness to learn new technologies and independently research unfamiliar topics.
• Interest in AI-assisted development, automation, and improving engineering productivity.
Nice to Have
• Experience with cloud platforms or SaaS development.
• Experience with API integration, automation scripts, or internal tool development.
• Familiarity with Git, CI/CD, Docker, Microservices, or related development environments.
• Experience using AI coding tools for development, debugging, or testing.
• Experience handling production issues or customer-reported software problems.
Who Will Enjoy This Role
If you tend to dig deeper when you encounter a bug because you want to understand why it happened, or when you see repetitive work and immediately think “Can I automate this?”, this role may be a great fit for you.
We are looking for someone who enjoys building things, learning quickly, and turning technical problems into practical solutions.
GitHub profiles, side projects, portfolios, automation tools, or other examples of hands-on development are welcome.
